title: Index of nonlinear Fredholm maps
statement: A \(C^1\) map \(F:M\to N\) of Banach manifolds is Fredholm if every \(DF_x\) is Fredholm. Its derivative index is locally constant, hence constant on connected \(M\). This does not define vector-space kernels or cokernels for \(F\) itself.
status: As of November 2026, Fredholm-map theory supplies the precise answer in this framework.

title: Stable index of a continuous Fredholm family
statement: For norm-continuous \(T:X\to\operatorname{Fred}(H)\), with compact Hausdorff \(X\), choose finite-dimensional \(V\) with \(T_xH+V=H\). Then \(E_x=T_x^{-1}V\) is a bundle and \([E]-[X\times V]\in K^0(X)\) is independent of \(V\).
status: As of November 2026, the index bundle answers the stable question; its rank is the numerical index.

title: Invariant subspaces of bounded Hilbert-space operators
statement: The intended question is whether every bounded operator on a separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space has a closed invariant subspace other than \(0,H\). The de Branges--Rovnyak affirmative announcement was retracted.
status: As of 12 November 2026, no generally accepted solution was verified in the literature checked. The unrestricted Hilbert-space problem remains distinct from its solved special classes and unverified claims.

title: Coordinate generators for the ball-algebra maximal ideal
statement: For \(A(B^n)=\mathcal O(B^n)\cap C(\overline B^n)\) and \(a\in B^n\), the ideal \(\{f:f(a)=0\}\) is generated by \(z_j-a_j\). The source asks \(n=2,a=0\).
status: As of November 2026, the exact ball question is solved; later counterexamples concern other domains.

title: Does Koopman spectrum determine a finite ergodic group action?
statement: The answer is negative even for transitive finite actions. Let \(G=GL(3,\mathbb F_2)\) act on the seven nonzero vectors of \(\mathbb F_2^3\), and on the seven nonzero covectors by the dual action. The permutation characters coincide, but the \(G\)-sets are not isomorphic. With uniform probability these are ergodic systems with unitarily equivalent Koopman representations.
status: As of November 2026, the finite-group question has a negative answer; this is not an open reconstruction problem.
